sources.title: HP Inc. is cutting up to 6,000 employees as it becomes the latest tech company to announce major layoffs | Fortune
sources.description: The layoffs come amid weaker sales and a faltering economy, with HP Inc.’s CEO describing it as a “volatile macro-environment.”

sources.title: After Meta, Twitter, Google, Amazon, HP decides to cut up to 6000 jobs - BusinessToday
sources.description: HP Inc currently employs nearly 50,000 people. The company has announced that it will sack around 4,000 to 6,000 employees in the coming years.
